description: encodeContent behaviour and the JSON Schemas the tools expose to the model. Encoding names are normalised first, so utf8/ascii/UTF-16 all route to a canonical target before dispatch.

write.js:writeFileTool.name: write_file
write.js:writeFileTool.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it does not exist, or overwrites if it does. Creates parent directories as needed.

path.description: Path to the file (relative to workdir or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

encoding.description: Optional file encoding (e.g. "ISO-8859-1", "windows-1252", "utf-16"). Defaults to "utf-8". Use the encoding reported by read_file to match project conventions.

edit.js:editFileTool.name: edit_file
edit.js:editFileTool.description: Replace specific text in a file. Use this for surgical edits. The old_string must match exactly (including whitespace and indentation).

path.description: Path to the file (relative to workdir or absolute)

old_string.description: Exact text to find and replace. Must match exactly including whitespace.

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences (default: false). If false and multiple matches found, the operation fails.

read.js:readFileTool.name: read_file
read.js:readFileTool.description: Read the contents of a file or list directory contents. For text files: returns file content. For images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG): returns base64-encoded data with MIME type metadata. For PDF files: extracts text content page by page. For directories: returns a tree-formatted listing of entries with file sizes.

path.description: Path to the file (relative to workdir or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start from (1-indexed). Default: 1. Only applies to text files.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read. Default: 2000. Only applies to text files.
